claim: EV004 inspects only CallExpressions whose member is Effect.scoped. Whole-body pipe(Effect.scoped) and Effect.fnUntraced interceptor references are invisible, so the detector both misses redundant runner-owned scopes and fails to retain shorter pipe-scoped lifetimes as judgment.
evidence: Source-derived, not executed. detectScopeLifetime in packages/tooling/tool/cli/src/commands/Lint/internal/EffectVitestDetectors.ts:791-816 requires canonicalMember === "scoped" and a CallExpression; inspectCall at :1239-1245 returns before any rule if the callee is not wrapperName/helperNames/detectorCallMembers, and detectorCallMembers at :53-88 omits pipe and fnUntraced. Pin packages/vitest/README.md:295-297 (rc.113 d3b837aee836f35d625d55205f7d6e61305fc198) forbids wrapping it.effect/it.live bodies in Effect.scoped. Counterexamples vs samples.json: apps/labs/api-docs/test/health.test.ts:22 is it.effect(..., () => verifyHealth().pipe(Effect.scoped)) with ordinal-20 empty rows; packages/drivers/tika/test/integration/Tika.server.live.test.ts:101-115 passes Effect.scoped as an fnUntraced interceptor with no EV004 row; apps/professional-desktop/test/tauri-ipc-socket.test.ts:152 is socket.reader.pipe(Effect.scoped, Effect.flip) with no EV004 row in the EV004 sample (rows exist only for Effect.scoped(...) calls). Detector EV004 fixtures only cover Fx.scoped(program) vs a hoisted fixture identifier.
proposedFix: Inspect Effect.scoped passed as a pipe stage or fnUntraced interceptor, not only as a direct call. Classify a whole-body pipe(Effect.scoped) as redundant-whole-body-scope; classify an inner pipe(Effect.scoped) as shorter-scope-lifetime-review. Add fixtures matching health.test.ts:22, Tika.server.live.test.ts:101-115, and tauri-ipc-socket.test.ts:152. Do not treat a hoisted Fx.scoped value identifier as whole-body.

claim: EV002 requires a provide/provideScopedLayer CallExpression inside an it.effect/it.live ancestor. A module-scoped curried provideScopedLayer bound to an identifier and passed as an fnUntraced interceptor is not a call, so per-test effectful layer provision is missed.
evidence: Source-derived, not executed. detectLayerProvision in packages/tooling/tool/cli/src/commands/Lint/internal/EffectVitestDetectors.ts:720-746 requires a CallExpression with publicProvider/localProvider/Effect.provide and effectRegistrationBody (:564-572: it.effect or it.live ancestor). inspectCall never sees a non-call interceptor. packages/drivers/tika/test/integration/Tika.server.live.test.ts:37 is const provideLive = provideScopedLayer(Layer.merge(FetchHttpClient.layer, NodeServices.layer)); :101-115 uses Effect.fnUntraced(..., Effect.scoped, provideLive) on every it.live. samples.json ordinal 5 has EV005/EV009/EV010 only — no EV002. Contrast packages/tooling/tool/cli/test/create-package-identity-template.test.ts:33 inline provideScopedLayer(NodeServices.layer), which is EV002. Detector test at packages/tooling/tool/cli/test/effect-vitest-detectors.test.ts:363-368 captures Fx.fnUntraced(..., provide(services)) only because provide(services) remains a CallExpression. D14 (goals/effect-vitest-canon/DECISIONS.md:23) requires it.layer for scoped/effectful layers; NodeServices.layer is not Layer.succeed/mock.
proposedFix: When an it.effect/it.live interceptor identifier resolves to a same-file provideScopedLayer/Effect.provide result, emit EV002 against that interceptor using the original layer expression. Keep the existing CallExpression interceptor fixture and add a Tika-shaped fixture: module-level const provideLive = provideScopedLayer(nonStub); it.live(..., Effect.fnUntraced(body, provideLive)).

claim: EV005 always prefers utils.assertExitSuccess. R2-006 polarity routing was applied only to EV006, so a detected Effect.result whose asserted branch is failure is still labeled as success.
evidence: Source-derived, not executed. EffectVitestRulePolicies EV005 in packages/tooling/tool/cli/src/commands/Lint/internal/EffectVitestPolicy.ts:65-71 sets primitive utils.assertExitSuccess. applyEffectVitestPrimitiveGraph at :264 uses finding.replacement.primitive only when ruleId === "EV006". standards/effect-vitest.primitives.jsonc entries utils.assertExitFailure (replaces EV005/EV006) and utils.assertExitSuccess (replaces EV005/EV006) both exist. packages/drivers/tika/test/integration/Tika.server.live.test.ts:192-198 is const outcome = yield* Effect.result(engine.extract(operation)); if (Result.isFailure(outcome)) expect(outcome.failure._tag)... samples.json EV005:packages/drivers/tika/test/integration/Tika.server.live.test.ts:192:result@31#1 has replacement.primitive utils.assertExitSuccess. Detector EV005 positive fixture is expect(Fx.result(program)).toBeDefined() with no failure-polarity case. Adjacent Json.test.ts:27-29 uses Effect.exit plus Exit.isFailure and is correctly routed as EV006 utils.assertTrue.
proposedFix: Give EV005 the same preferred-primitive override as EV006. If the asserted continuation is Result.isFailure/Exit.isFailure, select utils.assertExitFailure; if success, select utils.assertExitSuccess; if only a Boolean branch is present, keep review guidance and do not invent a Cause/payload. Add a Tika-shaped fixture. Do not reopen R2-006.
